directive/2.en:
Directive CMD-GA19 rev 1 to GA, after ["CMD-GA18"]
Goal: Implement METHOD rev 17 (na rule) and two requests from ga_rlo (GR1): guard state labels in turn evidence, and a clear error from ga prompt.
Why: BD-177: GA18 proposal on na; GR1 requests 1 and 2 (baseline#15) block ga_rlo G2 from putting rlo Sensor state into ga's own turn evidence.
Scope:
- S1: na rule: an items entry with state na and a non-empty evidence list is excluded from the partial-success floor; na with empty evidence counts as not met.
- S2: guard_summary accepts state lines from an operator guard record, e.g. {"kind":"state","labels":{name: value}}, and puts them in turns[].guards[].state (labels and values only, no raw text).
- S3: ga prompt without hub.guidance or session_guidance fails with a clear config error (exit 2, names the missing key), not a KeyError traceback.
- S4: README and DESIGN notes for S1-S3. No real runs.
Done when:
- D1: Tests for S1: na with reason excluded, na without reason counted, existing rev16 floors unchanged.
- D2: Tests for S2: state lines land in turns[].guards[].state; mixed guard and state lines counted correctly; no raw text stored.
- D3: Test for S3: missing guidance gives exit 2 and the key name.
- D4: Mutations for S1-S3 are all killed; full suite green on 3.10-3.13.
Budget: {"claude_p_runs": 0}
